source.content: @isTest private class QueryRuntimeSOQLSOSLRelationshipOptionsEvidenceTest { @isTest static void typeofAndPolymorphicRowsRun() { Account account = new Account(Name = 'Acme'); insert account; Contact contact = new Contact(LastName = 'Smith'); insert contact; Task accountTask = new Task(Subject = 'A', WhoId = account.Id); Task contactTask = new Task(Subject = 'C', WhoId = contact.Id); insert new List<Task>{ accountTask, contactTask }; List<Task> rows = [SELECT Id, Subject, Who.Name, TYPEOF Who WHEN Account THEN Name WHEN Contact THEN LastName END FROM Task ORDER BY Subject]; System.assertEquals(2, rows.size()); System.assertEquals('Acme', rows[0].Who.Name); System.assertEquals('Smith', rows[1].Who.LastName); } @isTest static void allRowsAndForViewRun() { Account viewed = new Account(Name = 'Viewed'); insert viewed; List<Account> referencedRows = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Id = :viewed.Id FOR REFERENCE]; System.assertEquals(1, referencedRows.size()); System.assertEquals('Viewed', referencedRows[0].Name); List<RecentlyViewed> recentRows = [SELECT Id, Type, LastViewedDate, LastReferencedDate FROM RecentlyViewed WHERE Type = 'Account']; System.assertEquals(1, recentRows.size()); System.assertEquals(viewed.Id, recentRows[0].Id); System.assertEquals(null, recentRows[0].LastViewedDate); System.assert(recentRows[0].LastReferencedDate != null); List<Account> viewedRows = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Id = :viewed.Id FOR VIEW]; System.assertEquals(1, viewedRows.size()); System.assertEquals('Viewed', viewedRows[0].Name); recentRows = [SELECT Id, Type, LastViewedDate, LastReferencedDate FROM RecentlyViewed WHERE Type = 'Account']; System.assertEquals(1, recentRows.size()); System.assertEquals(viewed.Id, recentRows[0].Id); System.assert(recentRows[0].LastViewedDate != null); System.assert(recentRows[0].LastReferencedDate != null); Account deleted = new Account(Name = 'Deleted'); insert deleted; delete deleted; List<Account> deletedRows = [SELECT Id, IsDeleted FROM Account WHERE Id = :deleted.Id ALL ROWS]; System.assertEquals(1, deletedRows.size()); System.assert(deletedRows[0].IsDeleted); } }
